event.summary: Deleted font and renderer services retain replacement metric lifecycle
event.detail: Reviewed commit: f560058da19e02716e6f943883a9508b447aff4e. TLDR: Considered whether deleting the DOM renderer, width cache and pixel-ratio services leaves terminal text misaligned or stale after zoom or display changes. The replacement explicitly owns that lifecycle. Details: assigned modules 3955, 1433 and 945 contain the old DOM renderer, width cache, character-size measurement, browser pixel-ratio monitor and render scheduler. grid-terminal.js:420-506 measures the bundled font, derives cell geometry, clears measured-glyph/reference caches and redraws/refits after remeasurement; :1946-1958 rearms its pixel-ratio watcher; :2017-2024 routes text-size changes through remeasure(); :609-614 coalesces paints; :615-783 lays out rows and boxes nonflowing glyphs to their declared cell widths; :2110-2139 disposes owned scheduling and watchers. SPEC_impl.md:1847-1867 defines the replacement fit and drawing contracts; its exact relevant text is: 'Drawing still rounds cells at the supervisor-committed size, never at the proposal reference.' It also specifies 'painted at most once per animation frame however many messages arrive'. The source implements these contracts; no requirement to preserve the retired cache implementation itself was found. Suggested bucket: high/material UX if such a regression existed. could-be-highest: no established security or loss-of-work consequence. Confidence: confirmed by source; no runtime execution. proposed_drop: source refutation. possible_cover: none; excluded coverage sources were not read. Caveat: the check covers ownership and invalidation of the removed services, not every visual glyph/font combination.

event.detail: Reviewed commit: f560058da19e02716e6f943883a9508b447aff4e. TLDR: The retired row factory recognizes overlined text, while the existing grid style mapper has no overline flag. This does not establish a regression introduced by this assigned deletion. Details: assigned module 1433 handles isOverline(); grid-style.js:42-57 defines the replacement flags and :145-217 resolves/decorates styles without overline. The complete patch for grid-style.js in the reviewed commit changes comments only. The parent revision's terminal.js:5954-5985 already constructs the same grid for terminal hosts, and no registerCharacterJoiner call exists in the parent revision's owned UI assets (git grep returned no matches outside vendor). SPEC_impl.md:1506-1514 makes the supervisor emulator and grid the terminal-host path, and SPEC.md:2999-3015 explicitly retires the old tmux terminals independently of this vendor deletion. Existing grid attribute limitations and optional unused character-joiner facilities are not independent defects of deleting the old renderer. Suggested bucket: other for the unestablished deletion concern; could-be-highest: no established security or work-loss route. event.summary: Grid-only terminal retirement loses previously served overline formatting
event.detail: Reviewed commit: f560058da19e02716e6f943883a9508b447aff4e; attribution checked over exclusive 6e423e30068b62c6cfa276c6d720ee35bb70387a through 00de0b6c9cf206f1a7c9c5ad1c76b5b10eaf85db. TLDR: Text a terminal program marked with an overline could be drawn that way in a served old terminal at the range base; after old terminals and xterm are removed, the only renderer has no way to draw that decoration. Details: at the exclusive base, assets/terminal.js:4679-4693 constructs xterm for known tmux terminals; :5363-5366 writes received live bytes to it. The base bundle's SGR handler sets bg bit 1073741824 for parameter 53 and clears it for 55; its AttributeData.isOverline reads the bit, assigned row factory module 1433 emits xterm-overline, and vendor/xterm.css:186-194 supplies the decoration. This is an active source route, not merely unused upstream code: base tmux.rs:2943-2950 documents live percent-output as byte-clean and bypassing tmux's saved grid; the complete QueryStripper table/feed in tmux/query_strip.rs:44-114 removes only fixed query strings, never SGR53; service/connection.rs:1789-1800 forwards byte events. Replay preservation by capture-pane is not claimed or needed for this live capability. Base SPEC.md:2817-2823 promises the actual TUI/full fidelity ('If it works over plain SSH it must work here'), while :2966-2993 serves existing old terminals alongside new ones. In-range dbfc69751215dbf15e1d31d5bed73c3754c4ebc4 changes supervisor startup from adopting that server to ending it and suppressing all old lookups; 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333 removes its driver; f560 deletes the old renderer. At the pinned tip SPEC.md:2855-2861 retains the full-fidelity statement, but assets/grid-style.js:43-57 lacks an overline flag and :170-217 only generates underline and line-through. event.summary: Selection, scroll anchoring and synchronized redraw have explicit replacement owners
event.detail: Reviewed commit: f560058da19e02716e6f943883a9508b447aff4e. TLDR: Considered whether deleting the old viewport/selection models and renderer scheduler loses selection or leaves an agent redraw permanently held. The replacement owns these behaviors in the grid and supervisor. Details: the assigned packet beginning module 8906 also removes Viewport; packet 1433 removes selection-render/selection models; packet 945 removes RenderService and its synchronized-output timeout. grid-terminal.js:510-599 anchors the view to absolute lines and hides history on the alternate screen; :928-947 clears invalidated selections and trims their surviving start; :1035-1195 owns selection endpoints, copied text and overlays; grid-buffer.js:133-155 reconstructs selected soft-wrapped text. Every completed gesture reaches onCopy at grid-terminal.js:1675-1683. For synchronized output, farhelm-terminal-emulator/src/emulator.rs:151-160 feeds through the buffering parser and :170-207 exposes and flushes its deadline. farhelm-supervisor/src/hosts/terminal.rs:3081-3102 waits on that deadline independently of program output; :3145-3157 flushes and publishes. SPEC_impl.md:2697-2707 explicitly assigns this to the supervisor, with a 150 ms safety deadline, not the deleted browser scheduler's one-second fallback. SPEC.md:3060-3082 defines local selection copying; the grid retains the local-selection path. Suggested bucket: high/material UX if either replacement owner were missing. could-be-highest: no established security or loss-of-work route in this concern. Confidence: confirmed from source, not execution. proposed_drop: source refutation of missing-owner concern. possible_cover: none; coverage sources not searched. Caveat: this is a deletion-contract check, not an independent audit of all stream recovery or clipboard-service behavior.
